description_ru: Опоздав на последний поезд, Томас встречает на платформе уличного музыканта.
text:
Thomas has missed many trains in his life, but he had never missed the last one before. It was almost midnight, and the station was nearly empty. He sat down on a cold bench and looked at his phone. The battery was dead.

"Rough night?" said a voice. A young woman with a violin case was sitting at the other end of the platform. Her name was Vera, and she played in the street every evening. "The next train leaves at five in the morning," she told him. "If you want, you can stay here with me. It's safer than walking home."

Thomas was tired and hungry, but he agreed. Vera opened her case, took out the violin and began to play a slow, quiet song. The music filled the empty station. A guard who was passing by stopped to listen, and then he smiled and gave them two cups of hot coffee.

They talked for hours. Vera had travelled to eleven countries with her violin, and she had never stayed in one place for more than a year. Thomas had never left his town.

When the first train finally arrived, the sky was turning pink. "If I ever find myself in your city again," Vera said, "I will play for you." Thomas laughed. For the first time, he wanted to buy a ticket to somewhere new.

focus_sounds.tip_ru: Верхние зубы слегка касаются нижней губы, звук звонкий; не оглушайте его в «ф».
Округлите губы в трубочку и быстро раздвиньте их; зубы не касаются нижней губы, иначе получится «в».
Долгий звук: растяните губы в улыбке и держите его дольше обычного русского «и».

questions.question: Why could Thomas not use his phone?
What did the guard give them?
